claims.notes: [BATCH NOTE b060] Batch covers lines 832-1088 (§ 8.2 to end of Changelog) of a pre-execution registration. Per the assignment, what the document REGISTERS (family size, q, test choices, floors, tie rule) is anchored to the least-writable artefact that carries it — for this registration that is the deliverable pair results/family-fdr/family_fdr.json and results/family-fdr/h1_cmt0106_pooled_modality.json, both of which exist in the working tree; values quoted FROM elsewhere are anchored to the artefact they live in, never to the prose that quotes them. Out-of-scope per instrument rule 5 and logged here rather than silently dropped: section references (§ 5.1.1, § 8.3), hypothesis and deviation identifiers (H1-H8, E28-E64, CMT-0106, GATE 1 ruling 7(c/d), Obs 375, Session 121), option numerals ((i)-(iv)), array indices inside backticked locators (comparisons[29]), line-number citations (§ 4 line 119), version strings (v1.0.0), dates, and commit hashes (2159d25b4, 562d185a...). || This claim: derivable from `inputs_ranked[i].report_as` in the anchor (entries whose text names a floor). Recorded verbatim without adjudication — the § 8.3 bullets below discuss H7 and H1 (bootstrap floor) and H2 plus H3 (permutation floor); the harness owns the comparison.

claims.claim_text:
Directional expectation, stated
   honestly from the visible level pairs: the text-only pool's members
   sit at or above every image-using member except that `image-only`
   drags its group down (brief-text beats image-only by +0.088), while
   the two `+image` conditions sit within ~0.02 of `brief-text`; the
   pooled delta should therefore be positive (text-only higher) but of
   modest size (~+0.03 on the crude full-set arithmetic), and whether it
   clears the family's BH threshold is **not predictable from the pair
   p-values**.
